entries.title: Proverbs 7:1
segments: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:2
segments: Keep my commandments and live; And my law as the apple of thine eye.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:3
segments: Bind them upon thy fingers; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:4
segments: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; And call understanding [thy] kinswoman:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:5
segments: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, From the foreigner that flattereth with her words.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:6
segments: For at the window of my house I looked forth through my lattice;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:7
segments: And I beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, A young man void of understanding,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:8
segments: Passing through the street near her corner; And he went the way to her house,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:9
segments: In the twilight, in the evening of the day, In the middle of the night and in the darkness.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:10
segments: And, behold, there met him a woman With the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:11
segments: She is clamorous and wilful; Her feet abide not in her house:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:12
segments: Now she is in the streets, now in the broad places, And lieth in wait at every corner.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:13
segments: So she caught him, and kissed him, [And] with an impudent face she said unto him:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:14
segments: Sacrifices of peace-offerings are with me; This day have I paid my vows.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:15
segments: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, Diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:16
segments: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, With striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:17
segments: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:18
segments: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; Let us solace ourselves with loves.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:19
segments: For the man is not at home; He is gone a long journey:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:20
segments: He hath taken a bag of money with him; He will come home at the full moon.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:21
segments: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield; With the flattering of her lips she forceth him along.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:22
segments: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox goeth to the slaughter, Or as [one in] fetters to the correction of the fool;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:23
segments: Till an arrow strike through his liver; As a bird hasteth to the snare, And knoweth not that it is for his life.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:24
segments: Now therefore, [my] sons, hearken unto me, And attend to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:25
segments: Let not thy heart decline to her ways; Go not astray in her paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:26
segments: For she hath cast down many wounded: Yea, all her slain are a mighty host.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:27
segments: Her house is the way to Sheol, Going down to the chambers of death.
